acceptance_criteria.finding: The 'Acceptance' section, the document's only stated done-criteria, gives no identifiable id or observable outcome, only the subjective 'the feature is done when it works well and users are satisfied with how it behaves.'

ambiguity.finding: The Acceptance section's normative done-condition uses unmeasurable language ('works well', 'users are satisfied with how it behaves') instead of a concrete, checkable standard.
